correctness.rationale: The order-two specialization matches Ma Theorem 2.3 and was verified independently in 1010 finite exact rational checks. P_h is positive compact, the rank-one Birman–Schwinger scalar is strictly decreasing from +infinity to zero, yielding precisely one simple negative eigenvalue. The uniformly O(n^-2) subtracted sum converges to exact -1/2 by harmonic telescoping, while the positive rank-one correction is O(h); a digamma identity inverts to κ(h)=4e^(γ−2)e^(−1/h)(1+o(1)). No extrapolation of finite spectra is used.

value.rationale: The first negative spectral mode of Ma’s canonical order-two interrupter emerges at a nonperturbative exp(-1/h) scale; its precise prefactor is a natural operator invariant and quantitatively refines the sharp hyponormality transition. It is neither an arbitrary tabulation nor a routine consequence of the known sign or rank-one decomposition, because a renormalized resolvent constant must be evaluated. The asymptotic makes explicit the fragility invisible to every finite power expansion.
